summary: This RFC describes procedures for using multipoint BFD to detect data plane failures on point-to-multipoint MPLS label switched paths and Segment Routing point-to-multipoint policies using SR-MPLS. It also updates an earlier RFC related to these mechanisms.

eli5.summary: When one speaker talks to many listeners, you want to know if any listener lost the signal. This is a quick way for the network to notice.

questions: how to detect failures on p2mp mpls paths
